slug: 2026-03-05 Kenya Government moves to introduce digital civil registration system (Births and Deaths Bill 2025)

facts.fact: The Star reports a three-day validation workshop, led by the State Department for Immigration and Citizen Services through the Civil Registration Service, on the Births and Deaths Registration Bill 2025, which gives a legal framework for digital registration; the service's Secretary called the current Act (Cap 149) outdated and paper-driven. The workshop is not dated in the text, so the published date is used.
facts.system: civil registration system under the Births and Deaths Registration Bill 2025

facts.fact: The Star reports that the State Department for Immigration and Citizen Services, through the Civil Registration Service, led the validation of the Births and Deaths Registration Bill 2025, with technical and financial support from Vital Strategies and the Global Health Advocacy Incubator. Published date used.
